title: sadcloud
description: Insecure AWS infrastructure by NCC Group, deployed into your own AWS account for training and for testing cloud auditing tools: wildcard and NotAction IAM policies, inline policies, PassRole, a role any AWS principal may assume, an S3 bucket without encryption, logging or versioning, and an unencrypted SQS queue.
question: Audit the account and identify every misconfiguration sadcloud planted.
